components.name: Cylinder block
components.description: Guides piston motion and contains exhaust, transfer, and intake ports.

components.name: Cylinder head
components.description: Seals combustion chamber and carries the spark plug.

components.name: Piston
components.description: Receives combustion pressure and moves along the cylinder.

components.name: Top piston ring
components.description: Helps seal gases against cylinder wall.

components.name: Wrist pin
components.description: Connects piston and small connecting-rod end.

components.name: Connecting rod
components.description: Transfers piston force to crankshaft and oscillates.

components.name: Crank pin
components.description: Connects the rod big end to the crank throw.

components.name: Flywheel
components.description: Stores rotational energy to smooth crank rotation.

components.name: Crankcase
components.description: Encloses crankshaft and precompresses incoming mixture.

components.name: Spark plug
components.description: Ignites compressed air-fuel mixture near top dead center.

components.name: Exhaust port
components.description: Allows burnt exhaust gases to escape when uncovered.

components.name: Transfer ports
components.description: Connect crankcase to cylinder during scavenging.

components.name: Intake port
components.description: Admits fresh mixture into crankcase during the induction phase.
